# FCDC_Architecture

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The Ferroelectric Charge-Domain Computing architecture that integrates HZO capacitors with attention mechanisms for in-memory analog computation. Demonstrates a practical hardware-software co-design approach bridging nonvolatile memory and neuromorphic attention, relevant to both TCC and iNEST.
